brewing.notes: A safe starting point for oolong: gongfu style with water just off the boil.

description:
Youxiang Qilan is a recent scented tea from Fujian, made by scenting Qilan with pomelo blossom. Qilan is a variety native to southern Fujian.

Recipes for a flavoured or scented tea vary from one maker to the next, so read the ingredient list and brew it like its base tea.
history: It is described as an innovation of recent years. Little more is documented about it.
processing: Qilan tea scented with pomelo blossom.
harvest_season: The base tea can come from any picking, so the season matters less than the recipe.
appearance_dry: Buds of the Qilan variety show clear white down.
appearance_liquor: Usually from golden to amber, depending on oxidation and roast.
appearance_wet: Usually whole leaves that open up, often with darker edges.
taste_profile: The base Qilan tea carries an orchid aroma.
vintage_note: Flavoured and scented teas are not sold by vintage. Buy recent stock and drink it within a year or so, since the aroma fades.
